subject: reasoning
question: Town C is to the west of Town D. Town E is to the east of Town C. Town F is to the north of Town D. Town G is to the north of Town E. Town G is to the north-west of Town D. What is the position of Town E with respect to Town D?
solution:
Given:

Town C is to the west of Town D. Town E is to the east of Town C. Town F is to the north of Town D. Town G is to the north of Town E. Town G is to the north-west of Town D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db58d360f93d6f801f391231640b0a289eedd8cc2b8ad715bb7d075d8a895d02.png] 

Thus, town E is to the west of town D.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
